themes_detail.label: Dead trees spike this week
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints surged to 4 reports THIS WEEK, a 540% spike above the 0.6 weekly average, suggesting either a sudden disease event, storm damage, or emerging tree health crisis in Far Rockaway parks and streetscapes.
evidence: 4 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 4.85, severity: high)
540% increase signals potential environmental or maintenance trigger
No recent news mentions or CB data available to contextualize cause
reporting_angles: Investigate whether recent weather (storms, freeze-thaw cycles) killed trees or if Parks Dept. maintenance is lagging
Map complaint locations to see if damage is concentrated in specific parks or neighborhoods

themes_detail.label: Street light failures worsening
themes_detail.summary: Street light complaints jumped to 38 reports last week, a 169% spike above the 14.1 weekly average, leaving residents in darkness and potentially creating safety hazards across the district.
evidence: 38 street light complaints last week vs. 14.1 weekly average (z-score: 5.14, severity: high)
169% increase suggests systemic infrastructure failure rather than isolated incidents
Safety implications for pedestrians, cyclists, and crime prevention
reporting_angles: Obtain DOE/DEP response times for street light repairs in Rockaways vs. other NYC neighborhoods
Interview residents about safety concerns in dark areas; map outages geographically
Check if aging infrastructure or budget constraints are causing delays in street light maintenance

themes_detail.label: Damaged street signs escalating
themes_detail.summary: Damaged street sign complaints hit 21 reports 2 weeks ago, a 600% spike above the 3.0 weekly average (z-score: 12.0), indicating rapid deterioration of directional infrastructure and potential traffic/navigation hazards.
evidence: 21 damaged street sign complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 3.0 weekly average (z-score: 12.0, severity: high)
600% increase is statistically extreme and suggests concentrated damage event
Related spike in dangling street signs (13 complaints, 174% above baseline) points to broader signage infrastructure problem
reporting_angles: Investigate whether storm damage or vehicle collisions caused the spike 2 weeks ago
Check DOT repair backlogs for the Rockaways and whether signage is deprioritized
Assess whether damaged signs are impacting navigation and emergency response in a vulnerable neighborhood

themes_detail.label: Noise complaints from commercial activity
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints jumped to 12 reports last week, a 231% spike above the 3.6 weekly average, suggesting new construction, entertainment venues, or industrial activity disrupting residential peace.
evidence: 12 commercial noise complaints last week vs. 3.6 weekly average (z-score: 5.31, severity: high)
231% increase coincides with active development pipeline (415 permits filed, including 148 new buildings)
Related spike in street/sidewalk noise (39 complaints, 140% above baseline) suggests multiple noise sources
reporting_angles: Cross-reference noise complaints with active DOB construction permits—are new Edgemere Commons or waterfront projects causing disruption?
Interview residents in complaint hotspots about which businesses or construction sites are the worst offenders
Examine whether construction hours are being violated or whether noise abatement requirements are being enforced

themes_detail.label: Water quality alerts resurface
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints reached 4 reports 3 weeks ago, a 3100% spike above the 0.1 weekly average, raising concerns about drinking water contamination or aging water infrastructure in a district with repeated DEP capital requests.
evidence: 4 water quality complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 11.72, severity: high)
3100% increase is extraordinary and suggests acute contamination event or pervasive quality issue
Community board has filed repeated capital requests for DEP sewer and water infrastructure projects, indicating chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Obtain DEP testing data for Rockaways water system around the time of spike; check for boil water advisories
Interview residents about what they observed (discoloration, odor, taste) and whether complaints were filed with DEP
Investigate whether aging pipes in Far Rockaway are corroding; review community board's infrastructure requests to show history of complaints
